name: 06614 · Stratford, CT
findings: ZIP 06614 (Stratford) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06614 (Stratford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
